chunks: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Al-Abbas b. al-Fadl narrated to us. He said: Abu Zur'a narrated to us. He said: Uthman b. Muhammad b. Abi Shayba al-Absi narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Numayr narrated to us, from al-Harith b. Hasira, from Abu Sulayman Zayd b. Wahb, from Abdullah ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
My wilaya and the wilaya of my Ahl al-Bayt is a safeguard from the Fire.

key_terms.أمان من النار: A safeguard from the Fire — protection from Hellfire granted through adherence to the Prophet and his family.
key_terms.ولاية أهل بيتي: The wilaya of my Ahl al-Bayt — the authority and guardianship entrusted to the Prophet's household.
key_terms.ولايتي: My wilaya — allegiance, authority, and spiritual guardianship of the Prophet over the believers.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about wilaya of the Ahl al-Bayt and protection from Hellfire?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Abbas records the Prophet's (s) declaration that devotion to him and to his Ahl al-Bayt serves as protection from Hellfire, emphasizing the salvific role of wilaya.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Al-`Abbas b. al-Fadl narrated to us. He said: Abu Zar`a narrated to us. He said: `Uthman b. Muhammad b. Abi Shayba al-`Absi narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Numayr narrated to us from al-Harith b. Hasira from Abi Sulayman Zayd b. Wahb from `Abdullah b. `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
My wilaya and the wilaya of my Ahl al-Bayt is a safeguard from the Fire.
